target.title: docs(xai): make grok-build-0.1 recommended for coding flows
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

`grok-build-0.1` exists in the xAI model catalog and is already noted for build/coding work, but guidance for the documented coding surfaces covered here (`coding-agent` skill and ACPX) was weak or missing.

Closes #99191

## Why This Change Was Made

This PR adds explicit recommendations, config examples, and a focused test assertion so operators know to prefer `xai/grok-build-0.1` for coding tasks via agent defaults or ACP session model selection where the selected harness supports that model ref.

All changes are documentation and a single catalog test assertion. Wording notes that external ACP harnesses own their auth, installed CLI, and accepted model ids.

## User Impact

Improves discoverability of the recommended Grok model for coding without affecting existing harness behavior or defaults.

## Evidence

Implemented:

- Documentation/examples across xAI provider docs, ACP agent docs, ACPX README, and the `coding-agent` skill.
- Focused xAI catalog assertion for `grok-build-0.1`.

Current-head proof for `3162b7b77e8f`:

```text
git diff --stat upstream/main...HEAD
 docs/providers/xai.md        | 5 +++++
 docs/tools/acp-agents.md     | 7 +++++++
 extensions/acpx/README.md    | 4 ++++
 extensions/xai/index.test.ts | 3 +++
 skills/coding-agent/SKILL.md | 3 +++
 5 files changed, 22 insertions(+)
```

Redacted terminal proof that the new guidance is present on the changed docs/skill surfaces:

```text
rg -n "xai/grok-build-0\.1|grok-build-0\.1|Grok Build" docs/providers/xai.md docs/tools/acp-agents.md extensions/acpx/README.md skills/coding-agent/SKILL.md extensions/xai/index.test.ts
extensions/xai/index.test.ts:330:    expect(result.provider.models.map((model) => model.id)).toContain("grok-build-0.1");
extensions/xai/index.test.ts:331:    expect(result.provider.models.find((model) => model.id === "grok-build-0.1")?.reasoning).toBe(
skills/coding-agent/SKILL.md:52:  `xai/grok-build-0.1`; external worker CLIs still own their own auth and
extensions/acpx/README.md:30:`xai/grok-build-0.1`. ACPX forwards model selection to the harness; the harness
docs/tools/acp-agents.md:140:    use `/acp model xai/grok-build-0.1`.
docs/tools/acp-agents.md:825:`xai/grok-build-0.1` for build/coding-focused sessions. ACPX forwards model
docs/providers/xai.md:136:Use `grok-4.3` for general chat and `grok-build-0.1` for build/coding-focused
docs/providers/xai.md:141:model ref `xai/grok-build-0.1` when the selected harness supports model
```

Validation:

```text
git diff --check upstream/main...HEAD
Result: passed.

pnpm docs:list
Result: completed.

node scripts/run-vitest.mjs run extensions/xai/index.test.ts
Result: passed, 1 file, 16 tests.
```

GitHub CI note:

- Repository CI ran for this PR. `check-docs` passed.
- One unrelated runtime-config shard failed: `checks-node-compact-small-whole-2`, in `src/config/sessions/session-accessor.reply-init-concurrency.test.ts`, with `SyntaxError: Unexpected end of JSON input`. That shard is outside this PR's docs/xAI catalog assertion surface.

Proof level claimed:

- `implemented`
- `test_proven` for the catalog assertion and docs-surface presence
- `code_proven` for no runtime/dependency surface change

Not claimed:

- `runtime_proven`.
- `end_to_end_proven`.

Additional local note:

- A Windows-host attempt to run `pnpm test:extension xai` reached 201/205 passing tests, but four unrelated `extensions/xai/web-search.test.ts` expectations failed on `/tmp` vs `C:\tmp` path normalization. Those tests do not cover the changed docs/catalog assertion.

## What Was Not Tested

- Live execution of ACP sessions or coding-agent background work using `grok-build-0.1`.
- Interaction with external harness auth flows.
- ACPX runtime, model forwarding, or harness adapter behavior changes.

## Scope Statement

This PR is intentionally small and limited to docs/examples plus one test assertion. It is separate from:

- PR #99088 for xAI realtime voice.
- The separate xAI streaming TTS branch.

## Dependency Statement

No dependency graph change. No new or modified runtime dependencies.
